The italicized 'his life' is an object the Hebrew does not write, with no object morpheme and no suffix in the clause, so it is `added` (rules 18, 44).
Both articleless participles are recast as relative clauses and keep the supplied relative with the attributive itself (rule 41's closing paragraph).
